items.title: ReNew Energy Q4 net declines 75%; FY26 PAT jumps twofold
items.description: ReNew Energy Global reported a significant 75% year-on-year decline in net profit for Q4FY26, reaching ₹77.7 crore. Despite this quarterly dip, the company's profit after tax for the full fiscal year FY26 more than doubled to ₹1,038.5 crore, driven by substantial revenue growth. ReNew Energy Global anticipates completing 1.6 to 2.4 GW of construction by March 31, 2027.
